spec.name: smh_own_local_icg_eg_ref-strongdecode-36b5c3a2b
spec.purpose: Factor mirror NAND5 into NAND2x2(AND4(originalA..D),NOR4(original busy/cgi)) to remove weak high-fanout decode driver, no Boolean or edge change. Duplicate original NOR4/NAND5 enable decode on dedicated local_cgi normal data pin (same original bit4 parent source), isolating mirror path from original late-register input hold buffers while retaining all original cut4 constraints. Six retained BUFx6f stages on auxiliary mirror clock branch; real generated GCLK exported at clock ports. Split mirrored original ENA into four critical XS/PT_E/PT_W gates and eight auxiliary gates with independent small commit clock roots, INVx4 direct local distribution. Move twelve original parent real ICGs inside distinct own master; mirror original ENA DFF and inverter on identical D/RAW clock to drive local gates without exported ordinary-data hold chain. Preserve all995 original logical registers and ordinary cut8870 data constraint; no cycle/phase relaxation.
